lines.text: What if *gravity* just switched off... for five seconds?
Every car here sits on springs, squeezed about *seventeen centimeters* by its own weight.
And nothing pulls anything back down.
A released spring throws each car up at almost a meter per second. Five seconds later, they're *four meters* in the air.
A four meter drop hits like a crash at *thirty-two* kilometers an hour. Three hundred and fifty-two times.
Follow for more. What should vanish next?
